source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls for proposals

parameters_passed_to_the_search_agent.search_scope: Open and forthcoming EU calls for proposals that are relevant to the energy sector in any way. Programmes to cover: Horizon Europe (mainly Cluster 5 'Climate, Energy and Mobility', Cluster 4 'Digital, Industry and Space', Cluster 3 'Civil Security for Society', Cluster 6 where a topic concerns the offshore or marine environment, the European Innovation Council, the Missions, and the European Partnerships and Joint Undertakings such as Clean Hydrogen), the Connecting Europe Facility for Energy, the Innovation Fund, the LIFE Clean Energy Transition sub-programme and the Digital Europe Programme. Each topic is its own FO, with the topic ID (for example HORIZON-CL5-2027-D3-01-05) as the call reference; the call ID (for example HORIZON-CL5-2027-D3-01) groups related topics. Also include cascade funding calls (open calls in which an EU-funded project passes part of its own grant on to third parties) that are relevant to the energy sector, from projects funded by any EU programme. Each open call is its own FO, and so is each challenge or track that the open call sets up with its own conditions; the project's open call title (for example 'Open Call 2') is the call reference. Skip calls for tenders, calls for experts, and I3 Instrument topics (they have their own source file).
parameters_passed_to_the_search_agent.navigation_instructions: 1. The portal is a JavaScript application. A plain page fetch returns an empty shell with no results, so use a browser. 2. Open the starting URL and set the filters: Status 'Open' and 'Forthcoming' (not 'Closed'), programming period 2021-2027, then one programme from the search scope at a time. The status filter is also in the address: status=31094502 is Open, 31094501 is Forthcoming, 31094503 is Closed. Example for Horizon Europe, open and forthcoming: https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-for-proposals?order=DESC&pageNumber=1&pageSize=50&sortBy=startDate&isExactMatch=true&status=31094501,31094502&programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027&frameworkProgramme=43108390 3. Horizon Europe has several hundred open and forthcoming topics. Narrow it with the programme part filter (the clusters, EIC, Missions, partnerships) named in the search scope, or with keywords such as energy, electricity, grid, transmission, offshore, flexibility, storage, hydrogen, critical infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital twin and artificial intelligence. 4. Set the page size to 50 and work through every result page. Screen each result by its title and topic ID, and open only those that could concern the energy sector. 5. Each result opens a topic page at .../screen/opportunities/topic-details/<TOPIC-ID>. It holds the general information (status, type of action, opening date, deadline or deadlines, single-stage or two-stage), the topic description (expected outcome and scope), the conditions and documents (eligible countries, the Work Programme part as PDF, templates), the budget overview and the topic updates. 6. The Work Programme part (PDF) is the authoritative text for eligibility, TRL, budget per project and conditions. The topic updates list amendments and deadline changes; compare them with what the FO record already holds. 7. TenneT TSO B.V. is a Dutch legal entity, so the Netherlands' eligibility is what matters; topics restricted to other countries or regions are out of scope. 8. Cascade funding calls appear in the same results list and open a page at .../screen/opportunities/competitive-calls-cs/<number>, not a topic page. If the results list offers a filter for cascade funding, screen these calls in a separate pass with the same keywords. The portal page is only a summary: follow its link to the open call's page on the issuing project's own website, where the call text and the guide for applicants are the authoritative documents for eligibility, amounts and deadlines. Many cascade calls are open only to SMEs or startups; record them anyway, since the assessment decides their call type.
parameters_passed_to_the_search_agent.link_scope: Pages under ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/ (result lists, topic pages, budget overviews, call documents), and Work Programme or call documents linked from a topic page on other europa.eu websites (for example a Joint Undertaking's call page). For a cascade funding call only: the open call's page and its call documents on the issuing project's own website, reached from the portal's cascade call page. Do not follow links to the submission system, partner search, login pages, news, or other websites outside europa.eu, and on a project's website open nothing but the open call's page and documents (no news, registration, application forms or other project pages).
parameters_passed_to_the_search_agent.completion_rules: The run is complete when, for every programme in the search scope, every page of the Open and Forthcoming results has been screened and every relevant topic and cascade funding call has been opened. If the run reaches the cap of 5 new candidates first, stop there: later runs skip the calls already recorded and find the rest. A run that screens everything and finds no new call ends with no new FO.
